EXPERIENCE HIGHLIGHTS EXAMPLES
CENTRAL BANK OF THE BAHAMAS

Caiman Automation Solution is one of the consultant companies as part as the Facility Master System of the new building for the Central Bank of the Bahamas. Handling the control and supervision of mechanical systems using direct digital controls (DDC) and other types applied to HVAC and non-HVAC systems.

LYNDEN PINDLING INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

Brayan Turnquest was in charge of the Building Management System (BMS) as part of Nassau Airport Development Company (NAD) for over 3 years, carrying out the implementation of maintenance and upgrades on the airport system.

HOTEL IBEROSTAR GRAND PACKARD

Brayan Turnquest was one of the engineers who carried out all the stages and full implementation of the Hotel Automation Project from the design and assembly of the panels to the implementation of the SCADA supervision system
